Saarbrücken ( German pronunciation: [zaːɐ̯ˈbʁʏkn̩] ⓘ ; Palatine German : Saarbrigge : [zaːˈbʁɪɡə] ; French: Sarrebruck [ 5 ] [saʁbʁyk] ; Luxembourgish : Saarbrécken [zaːʁˈbʀekən] ⓘ ; Latin : Saravipons ; lit. ' Saar Bridges ' ) is the capital and largest city of the state of Saarland , Germany. Saarbrücken has 181,959 inhabitants and is Saarland's administrative, commercial and cultural centre. It is located on the Saar River (a tributary of the Moselle ), directly borders the French department of Moselle , and is Germany's second-westernmost state capital after Düsseldorf .
